title: create_vehicle_with_valid_data
description: Test POST /api/v1/cars with valid marca, modelo, and patente to ensure a vehicle is created successfully and a 200 response with the vehicle Guid is returned.

title: create_vehicle_with_duplicate_patente
description: Test POST /api/v1/cars with a patente that already exists to verify the API returns a 400 validation error and does not create a duplicate vehicle.

title: update_vehicle_with_valid_data
description: Test PUT /api/v1/cars/{id} with valid update data to confirm the vehicle is updated successfully and a 204 NoContent response is returned.

title: update_vehicle_with_nonexistent_id
description: Test PUT /api/v1/cars/{id} using a nonexistent vehicle id to ensure the API returns a 404 NotFound response.

title: list_vehicles_with_authentication
description: Test GET /api/v1/cars with a valid authentication token to verify the API returns a 200 response with a paginated list of vehicles.

title: list_clients_with_authentication
description: Test GET /api/v1/clients with a valid auth token to ensure the API returns a 200 response with a paginated list of clients.

title: create_client_with_valid_data
description: Test POST /api/v1/clients with valid firstName and lastName to verify a client is created successfully and a 200 response with the client Guid is returned.

title: create_client_with_missing_name_fields
description: Test POST /api/v1/clients with missing firstName or lastName to confirm the API returns a 400 validation or request error.

title: create_financial_transaction_with_valid_data
description: Test POST /api/v1/financial with valid amount and type to ensure a financial transaction is created successfully and a 200 response with the transaction Guid is returned.

title: create_financial_transaction_with_invalid_data
description: Test POST /api/v1/financial with invalid amount or missing required fields to verify the API returns a 400 validation error.
